responsibilities: Built Python data processing pipelines for large instrument-data batches with multiprocessing and automated output routing, cutting processing time by about 60%.
Designed a modular Selenium and PyTest automation framework for the Reagent Probe Carryover web tool, reducing regression testing from a full day to under 2 hours.
Parsed instrument logs and Excel outputs with Python to compare actual results against expected values and speed up root-cause analysis.
Debugged 30+ issues across BioPlex Data Tools applications by tracing behavior through UI flows, browser tools, logs, and calculation outputs.
Verified clinical-statistical logic including Deming regression, Passing-Bablok regression, one-way ANOVA, and Wilson score confidence intervals across 4 clinical tools and 100+ test cases.
Used Claude and Codex for automation development, data parsing, log analysis, and Jira defect report drafting.
Built and maintained Python FastAPI microservices backed by PostgreSQL, supporting 90+ concurrent users with async endpoints, task queuing, and FHIR-based healthcare data handling.
Improved two production services with database indexes and structured logging, cutting average response latency by about 40% and P1 incidents by 45%.
Developed a REST API eligibility engine that flags pulmonary embolism risk from demographic and clinical criteria, matching clinician review in 94% of 167 validated cases.
Built a React and TypeScript review dashboard where clinical users could search, filter, and review flagged patient cases with smooth loading and error states.
Containerized a healthcare data pipeline on AWS EC2 with S3 storage, using Docker workers to process 10,000+ clinical records while cutting compute costs by 90%.
Built full-stack features for an enterprise Client Insights platform using Angular, TypeScript, .NET Core REST APIs, and SQL Server for 200+ daily users.
Led a data visualization module with reusable Angular components, RxJS async flows, and optimized SQL aggregation logic, raising adoption from 23% to 63%.
Designed a .NET Core microservice for template-based PDF generation, producing 500+ branded reports per month and saving about 15 hours weekly.
Raised test coverage from 58% to 84% with unit tests and Selenium end-to-end suites, then used that coverage to catch and fix 70+ production defects.
Rebuilt Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines with caching and parallel jobs, cutting deployment time from 60 to 32 minutes and reducing rollback incidents by 67%.

projects.title: SupportPilot
projects.description: A support triage and RAG reply engine combining hybrid retrieval, citation-grounded Claude replies, PII redaction, and confidence-based escalation.
projects.long_description: TF-IDF and MiniLM embeddings classify approximately 24,000 deduplicated messages across 27 intents. On a 108-ticket evaluation set, intent accuracy was 90.7% and team routing accuracy was 99.1%. Intent accuracy reached 96.2% on the 72% of evaluated tickets selected for automated handling.
features: Hybrid TF-IDF and MiniLM retrieval
93.5% Recall@1 and 0.963 MRR
90.7% intent accuracy on 108 evaluated tickets
99.1% team-routing accuracy on the evaluation set
PII redaction and confidence-based human escalation

projects.title: Micro-Observer
projects.description: A real-time system monitoring dashboard with FastAPI metric collection, PostgreSQL persistence, React charts, and alert cooldowns.
projects.long_description: Micro-Observer turns raw machine telemetry into a live operations view. A FastAPI service collects CPU, memory, and process metrics every 5 seconds, stores historical readings with SQLAlchemy/PostgreSQL, and streams useful slices to a React and TypeScript dashboard with Recharts visualizations and threshold-based alerting.
features: Live metric collection every 5 seconds
Historical system telemetry persisted in PostgreSQL
Interactive Recharts dashboards for fast trend scanning
Threshold alerts with cooldowns to reduce noisy notifications
Docker Compose setup for repeatable local development

projects.title: Clinical Risk Eligibility Engine
projects.description: A healthcare REST API and review workflow that flags pulmonary embolism risk from clinical and demographic criteria.
projects.long_description: Built from production healthcare experience, this system translates clinical stakeholder rules into a traceable eligibility engine. It combines FastAPI, PostgreSQL, structured logs, and a React review dashboard so clinical teams can search, filter, and validate flagged patient cases.
features: Clinical criteria modeled as maintainable API logic
FHIR-aware healthcare data handling
Review dashboard with search, filters, and clear loading states
Structured logging for production debugging
CI checks for backend tests and frontend builds

projects.title: Sherlog
projects.description: An incident investigation agent that connects logs, metrics, deployments, and runbooks to produce cited diagnoses, and abstains when evidence conflicts.
projects.long_description: A bounded LangGraph workflow with four read-only tools. A deterministic evaluation on 12 synthetic incidents achieved 100% root-cause accuracy versus 58.3% for a log-only baseline. This is a small synthetic benchmark, not a production accuracy claim.
features: Four read-only investigation tools
Cited diagnoses with evidence checks
Abstention for incomplete or conflicting evidence
12 synthetic incident evaluation cases
26 automated tests

projects.title: Distributed Task Scheduler
projects.description: A fault-tolerant task scheduler with Celery workers, Redis queues, PostgreSQL task state, FastAPI endpoints, retries, and a live React dashboard.
projects.long_description: This project focuses on reliability under worker failure. It uses Celery and Redis for distributed execution, PostgreSQL for recoverable task state, priority queues for scheduling, exponential backoff retries, FastAPI endpoints for task control, and a React dashboard for live task tracking.
features: Priority queues and retry policies with exponential backoff
Persistent task state for crash recovery
FastAPI control plane for task creation and status checks
React dashboard for live worker and task visibility
PyTest coverage around scheduling and recovery behavior

projects.title: CareerLens
projects.description: A job-search copilot that parses resumes, ranks jobs against evidence, identifies skill gaps, and exposes shared capabilities through FastAPI and MCP tools.
projects.long_description: CareerLens connects resume parsing, evidence-grounded job ranking, skill-gap analysis, and recruiter outreach generation. Job freshness filtering and duplicate detection keep results useful, while shared endpoints and MCP tools make the workflow available across interfaces.
features: Resume parsing and evidence-grounded matching
Skill-gap analysis
Shared FastAPI endpoints and MCP tools
Job freshness filters and duplicate detection
Outreach generation and automated CI testing
projects.evaluation: Freshness filters, duplicate detection, and automated CI tests

projects.title: BioPlex Automation Framework
projects.description: A modular Selenium and PyTest framework for validating clinical web tools, instrument outputs, and statistical calculations.
projects.long_description: This framework treats QA as engineering infrastructure. It uses reusable fixtures, parameterized scenarios, Python log parsers, and Excel comparison utilities to validate instrument-data workflows and clinical calculation outputs with less manual effort.
features: Reusable Selenium fixtures for stable browser automation
Parameterized test coverage for 25+ regression scenarios
Python parsers for logs and instrument output files
Regression validation reduced from a day to under 2 hours
Clear defect reports with repro steps and root-cause notes
